column1: # renames_low.tsv — LOW-confidence Ghidra symbol renames for the fft-ghidra project.
# Format: tab-separated. Comments start with #. Blank lines ignored.
# Columns: address \t binary \t type \t name \t description
#   address      hex with 0x prefix, lowercase preferred (e.g. 0x801a634c)
#   binary       BATTLE | SCUS | E001..E511 | * (any program); comma-separated for multiple
#   type         FN  = function (creates if needed; skips mid-instruction)
#                DEL = revert any USER_DEFINED name at this address back to FUN_*/DAT_*
#   name         the new symbol name; for DEL rows use - as a placeholder
#   description  freeform; convention is "what + confidence evidence". For LOW, prefix
#                with `Hyp:` to distinguish hypotheses from facts. No literal tabs.
# Apply order: this file is applied FIRST. renames_high.tsv overrides any conflicts.
# To add a hypothesis-quality name as you work: append a row here. When you've
# behaviorally validated it (decomp confirmation, parity match against a
# reimplementation, wiki citation), move the row to renames_high.tsv and
# --- HUD number font (FRAME.BIN digits) --- supporting cast; disasm-reported, not yet independently cross-checked.
